analysis:
This batch contains only test and test-harness changes. No production source is supplied.

PlacementSetupCheck.swift (head 1260-1264): the publicTrafficLine checks now pass publicModels: []. The tests assert that a family with no passing record is notYetQualified, and that a passing hand-off family is labelled "qualified for public traffic" when there is no public declaration. This implies a new publicModels parameter in production ClusterPairServingGrants.publicTrafficLine, likely sourced from ClusterPublicModels.swift, which run.sh now compiles (head line 41). That source is not supplied. Integration should verify:
- how publicModels is populated and whether it is trusted;
- whether a declared public model can mark a family qualified for public traffic without passing qualification records.
That would bear on A-017, T-054 and T-052.

The rest of PlacementSetupCheck (953-1424) is unchanged test logic about owner serving and grants.

ClusterOnboardingScopeSettingsTests.swift (new, marked UNRUN): tests that `cluster local --bind 127.0.0.1` sets servingScope to localOnly, and that plain onboarding and service settings leave it nil. The implementation of the local bind scope is not supplied. Integration should check that localOnly cannot expose an unauthenticated listener beyond loopback.

ClusterRuntimeFactsCommandTests.swift: adds parse tests for --list-release-models and --release-candidates mode exclusivity; the command stays hidden.

ClusterRuntimeApprovalFactsTests.swift: unit d603260f640512a9:0 is metadata only. Per the range map it has large changes (release-version rows, a Gemma artifact shared by two model names), but its content was not visible in this batch. That is a coverage gap.

No concrete regression is visible in the supplied lines.
